HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH A SERIES OF INPUTS FROM THE AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS INTENDING TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE-BASED INPUT.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is the case of a 62-year-old male, resident of West Bengal, and Government official by occupation (currently retired). The following history was taken with the patient in person. The patient was explained about confidentiality and written consent was taken to create the following case report.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003EThis case report aims to record the patient's journey.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- HTN since 25 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Knee pain on both legs since 2 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- Diminishion of vision in left eye since 1 year.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of present illness:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient is apparently asymptomatic 25 years back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUpon regular doctor checkup, the patient was diagnosed with \u003Cb\u003EHypertension\u003C\/b\u003E. He reports to be following a \u003Cb\u003Esedentary\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Elifestyle\u003C\/b\u003E. His hypertention was in control with the help of medications prescribed by the local doctor throughout his work life. After retirement (in the year \u003Cb\u003E2021\u003C\/b\u003E), the patient reports to have had recurrences of \u003Cb\u003Eheadache\u003C\/b\u003E and being \u003Cb\u003Eirritable\u003C\/b\u003E. Upon consultation with the local doctor, he was prescribed medications (which are listed in the report section).\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn the year of \u003Cb\u003E2021\u003C\/b\u003E, the patient also complains of \u003Cb\u003Eknee pain on both legs\u003C\/b\u003E. The pain is \u003Cb\u003Einsidious\u003C\/b\u003E on onset and \u003Cb\u003Egradually\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Eprogressive\u003C\/b\u003E. The patient noticed the pain on the \u003Cb\u003Eright knee first\u003C\/b\u003E after it gradually progressed to the left knee. The pain was of \u003Cb\u003Edragging type\u003C\/b\u003E. It is \u003Cb\u003Econtinuous\u003C\/b\u003E in its presence. The pain would \u003Cb\u003Eincrease\u003C\/b\u003E when the patient endulges in \u003Cb\u003Ephysical exercise\u003C\/b\u003E or extensive walking and would \u003Cb\u003Erelieve\u003C\/b\u003E upon taking \u003Cb\u003Epain medications\u003C\/b\u003E.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003ELast year\u003C\/b\u003E, the patient complains of \u003Cb\u003EDiminision of vision in the left eye\u003C\/b\u003E. The patient also complains of \u003Cb\u003Eswelling on the left lateral aspect of the thigh\u003C\/b\u003E. The swelling is sudden in onset and\u0026nbsp; intermittent in its presence. There is burning sensation. There is no tenderness and the patient is able to perform physical activities inspite of the swelling. The swelling reduces by itself.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EDaily schedule of the patient:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn the patient's words:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\"I wake up at 7 in the morning, wash my hands and do exercise until about ten o'clock, drink water after exercise, then drink tea. After drinking tea, I help my wife in the kitchen. I eat bread and vegetables at 11:30 for cooking, then take medicine, exercise my wife's legs, and take a steam bath myself. Then I do household chores, market, etc., return home, rest for a while, take a bath. By five o'clock I water some plants in the roof garden. After watering, wash hands, wear newspaper, eat tea at seven o'clock, then watch TV and exercise my legs. After exercise, exercise my wife's legs at ten o'clock. I go to eat at 10:45, watch TV for a while and go to bed by 12:30 to 12:30. This is my daily routine.\"\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of past illness:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient does not have any history of TB, DM, Epilepsy and asthma.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient has a history of HTN since 25 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EFamily history:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient's father, mother, 2 elder brothers and 1 elder sister is reported to be suffering from HTN.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient's mother also has a history of piles.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPersonal history:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWater intake:- 1-1.5L\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite:- normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet:- mixed (does not consume mutton and egg)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel movement:- Normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EThe patient has a history of piles from his student life (approximately in the year 1972) till the year he was married. This was resolved upon medication.\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBladder movement:- Normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlcohol:-\u0026nbsp; No consumption\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESmoking:- No consumption\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAllergies:- No known allergies\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExercise status:-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was cooperative, conscious, coherent and the examination was done in a well lit and well ventilated room.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor:- Slight pallor observed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIcterus:- none\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EClubbling:- present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECyanosis:- none\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELymphadenopathy:- none\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema:- pitting type of edema observed.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECLINICAL Y female with joint pains"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E19th July 2023\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: THIS IS AN ONLINE E LOGBOOK TO DISCUSS OUR PATIENT'S DE-IDENTIFIED HEALTH DATA SHARED AFTER TAKING HIS\/HER GUARDIAN'S SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT. HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH A SERIES OF INPUTS FROM THE AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS INTENDING TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE-BASED INPUT.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is the case of a\u0026nbsp;60 year old female, an agricultural laborer by occupation (stopped working 4 years ago) and resident of Guramguda.\u0026nbsp;The following history was taken with the patient in person. The patient was explained about confidentiality and written consent was taken to create the following case report.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003EThis case report aims to record the patient's journey.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-pain in both knees since 4-5 years,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-facial swelling since 2-3 months,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-pedal edema since 1 week.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 4-5 years ago. She then started developing pain in both her knees which is aggravated on walking and standing, relieved on resting and medications (painkillers). She stopped working due to the pains.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2-3 months ago, she developed facial puffiness which was insidious in onset and gradually progressive in nature. It appears maximally in the mornings and gets relieved by the end of the day.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1 month ago, she had a tooth extraction on the left side and still has facial puffiness on the left side.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1 week ago, she had pedal edema upto her ankles which was pitting in nature. This also appears maximally in the morning and subsides by the end of the day. Her edema greatly subsided by itself after a week.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe came to the hospital now to find a working solution for her joint pains and to find out about why her pedal edema appeared and disappeared.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDAILY ROUTINE:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient wakes up in the morning at 5:30 and begins household chores, eats breakfast at 8:00. She smokes tobacco at this time.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe then passes her time by talking with family members or guests till 11:00, when she cooks her lunch and eats lunch late, around 3:00-4:00pm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe has tea occasionally in between, when she visits family. She spends time sleeping or talking with friends and family in person or on the phone.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt night, she doesn't feel hungry. She may or may not smoke tobacco again. She then sleeps at around 10:00pm.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis has been her routine since 4 years, after she stopped working.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case of diabetes, hypertension, CVA, CAD, TB, asthma\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot significant.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient has a history of using NSAIDS 3-4 days a week since 4 years for the joint pains, suggested by and RMP.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet: mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel movements: regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMicturition: normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo known allergies\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions: Smokes tobacco once or twice a day everyday\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMENSTRUAL HISTORY:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAttained menopause 20 years ago.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient is conscious, coherent, cooperative and well-oriented to time, place and person.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient is moderately built and well-nourished.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, koilonychia, lymphadenopathy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema present in right The patient was explained about confidentiality and written consent was taken to create the following case report.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis case report aims to record the patient's journey.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Came for regular dialysis as per schedule.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness:-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 4 years back. Afterwards, he had consistent episodes of vomiting (frequecy the patient doesn't remember) and pitting type edema on both ankles. He went to a local hospital where he was diagnosed with CKD. He was on injection since 2 years (name unknown). The patient also had grade 2 sob and generalised weakness during the same period of time.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O of chest pain, palpitations, cold, fever, cough.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDAILY ROUTINE:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient follows a sedentary lifestyle. He generally wakes up at 6:30 am and has breakfast which generally consists of milk, on 7am. Later he has lunch which mainly consists of rice at around 11:20am. The patient generally doesn't have dinner\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of past illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient has HTN since 3 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient does not have any history of DM, TB, Epilepsy, and asthma.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESurgical history\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo significant surgical history.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient has been undergone blood transfusion approximately 12 times since his dialysis started.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWater intake:- half a litre per day\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite:- reduced\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet:- mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel movement:- normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBladder movement:- normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAlcohol:- occational consumtion for fifteen years.
